record.question: Abhinav Bindra won Gold Medal in the Beijing Olympics in which event?
record.explanation: IOC identifies Bindra's Beijing 2008 gold as men's 10 m air rifle, a shooting event. Historical exam context: 2010-03-24 (full date printed on cover). This is the source-era answer; time-sensitive roles, rankings and memberships may have changed. Evidence: https://www.olympics.com/ioc/news/india-s-pioneering-marksman-abhinav-bindra-is-growing-sport-at-grassroots-level Independently checked solution, unofficial.
